headline: Indonesian Nickel Reference Prices Rise Amid Continued Gold Decline
seoTitle: Nickel Prices Increase Amid Gold Price Decline
metaDescription: Indonesian nickel reference prices have reached US$15,596 per ton as gold prices experience consecutive daily declines across national markets.
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesian nickel reference prices increased to US$15,596 per ton for late November 2026.
Gold prices in Indonesia have recorded consistent declines over several consecutive days.
Major state-backed gold brands including Antam and Galeri24 reported downward price adjustments.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian commodity market is currently observing a divergence between nickel and gold valuations. Nickel reference prices have shown a positive trend, increasing by approximately four percent to reach US$15,596 per ton as of late November 2026. Conversely, the domestic gold market is experiencing a downward trajectory. Major distributors such as Antam have reported daily price reductions, with one gram of Antam gold recently priced at Rp2,511,000 following a decline of Rp3,000. Market reports indicate that this downward trend for gold has persisted for three consecutive days, impacting buyback rates and the valuation of other prominent brands available through national pawn service providers. Analysts and financial news outlets continue to monitor these fluctuations as the nickel sector maintains growth against the broader weakening of precious metal retail prices within the country.
whyItIsViral: This topic is covered by five independent outlets with a moderate pace of reporting, reflecting significant interest in the shifting values of key Indonesian commodities.
